one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three draws, all sharing this session's single $15.1475 ceiling. It may never have two resources billing at once: SessionRunner.release_and_confirm requires the PROVIDER to report an abandoned pod not billing before the next is created, and aborts the session if that cannot be confirmed.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization. Unchanged -- what the 2026-09-11 amendment withdrew is the cap on how many such sessions may exist, not the rule that each authorization funds exactly one.
one_use.after_consumption: this grant is spent. A further session needs a NEW grant, a NEW launch-bound readiness record, a NEW one-use authorization and a NEW bundle.

package.amended: 2026-09-11, withdrawing the session cap and the one-resource rule, prospectively
package.limits_do_not_transfer: the engineering allowance, the per-session ceiling, the package total and the project cap bind separately. Money now bounds how many sessions are possible; there is no separate count.
package.acquisition: up to 3 host draws in this session, one billing resource at a time, each abandoned draw released with provider confirmation and recorded with its own pod id, cost and watchdog. create_attempts stays 1: draws replace an unusable host, they do not chase stock.
package.stop_and_report: formal probe training started; whether it started cannot be confirmed; a real replay mismatch; a frozen-science conflict; unverifiable evidence provenance; or any complete valid GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE, all three of which end this round.
package._sessions_note: attempts 10 through 17. Attempt 17 trained all six formal probes and measured nothing: $11.1866. Three attempts cost $0.

pre_provider_refusal: a pre-provider gate refusal costs $0.00 and creates nothing, but under this package it still CONSUMES this attempt, because the launcher was invoked under an issued one-use authorization. _capacity_note: this grant does not wait on a stock LABEL. Attempt 12 was refused at a 'Low' reading, and 'Low' is not 'none' -- attempt 10 launched at 'Medium' and attempt 11 at 'Low', and neither label predicted the outcome. A null reading is UNKNOWN, not available and not permanently unavailable. What gates the launch is the live securePrice quote at or below the accepted $1.09/h and every pre-provider gate, not an inventory adjective. Repeated create calls to chase stock remain unauthorized; create_attempts stays 1. Attempts 13 and 14 add nothing to that reading: one never reached a quote, and the other acquired at $1.09/h on the first draw.
_why_this_attempt_exists: attempt 17 replayed both frozen digest gates, materialized both arms and trained all six probes, then failed in stage H before generating a single token: uncapped_eval.py handed apply_chat_template the battery's `tools` field as a JSON string. battery_render.py, the scoring renderer, had always parsed it; the generation renderer did not, and the renderer-parity gate exercises the scoring one. Repaired with the same conversion and validated at $0 over all 100 tool samples with the real frozen tokenizer. Completed probes are now pushed to durable storage the moment they finish, so a later stage's failure cannot discard them again.
_this_is_a_fresh_complete_execution: not a continuation of attempt 17. Stage B onward runs in full: replay parent, replay incumbent, materialize both arms, train all six probes, evaluate all six, score, and the frozen Stage-I decision. No reuse or pooling from attempt 17, no stopping after one arm, and no adaptive rerun based on observed results.
_narrow_retry_authority: the same maintainer decision established, for the remaining C1 package, that an attempt which reaches formal training and then aborts on a deterministic defect BEFORE any confirmation sample is generated or scored may be closed, repaired, revalidated at $0 and rerun autonomously from the beginning -- while samples generated and scored are both zero, no arm endpoint was observed, no decision exists, no checkpoint is reused, all six probes are retrained, frozen science is unchanged, the budget funds the fresh run, the GPU class and price are unchanged and provider ownership is reconciled. The authority ends the instant any confirmation output has been observed. See logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-09-14.
